finalText:
All 40 tests pass now.

Bug: `computeTotal` in `src/pricing/engine.js` round to USD cents after percent step AND after flat step, then round again after currency convert — three roundings total. Spec want one rounding, at end, in target currency. Extra early rounding in USD introduce sub-cent drift that convert rate (GBP 0.78, CAD 1.35, JPY 149) amplify into wrong final cent. Explain "most look fine": USD/EUR combos happen not to cross rounding boundary, only percent-coupon + non-USD/EUR combos trip it — matches observed 10 failures exact.

Fix: removed intermediate `round()` calls in percent/flat steps, keep single round at end (engine.js:23-27).
